_doc: DayZero modes. Edit freely; the wizard reads this file at start.
apps:    ids from apps.json, installed and ticked by default on the review screen.
tweaks:  ids from tweaks.json. Tweaks marked optional there only appear as switches on the review screen.
debloat: suggested clean-up level (clear, minimal, standard, advanced; see debloat.json). Only used when the USB builder did not pick one.
office:  true installs Microsoft 365 Apps with the Office Deployment Tool (office.json).
includes: other modes merged into this one (apps and tweaks are combined).
custom:  true = nothing pre-ticked; the user picks everything (in the builder or on the review screen).
The review screen always shows the whole app catalog and every tweak, so any mode can be adjusted.

modes.title: GAMING
modes.description: Game launchers, chat and capture tools, your graphics card's app and the gaming tweaks that actually do something.
highlights: Steam, Epic, Discord, OBS, Afterburner, HWiNFO
Game Mode, GPU scheduling, raw mouse input
Performance power plan (asks first on laptops)

modes.title: OFFICE
modes.description: Microsoft 365 Apps plus the everyday essentials, and no performance tweaks.

modes.title: EVERYTHING
modes.description: Gaming and Office together, plus PowerToys, VS Code, Windows Terminal and the runtimes many apps and games need.

modes.title: CUSTOM
modes.description: Nothing is ticked until you tick it: choose your browsers, messengers, AI apps, Microsoft 365 and each tweak. Picks made in the USB builder arrive pre-ticked.
highlights: Browsers, messaging, AI apps and more
Nothing happens that you didn't tick
